questions.question: How many hairs are on a typical brown-haired person's head?
questions.fact: It depends on colour: blond heads have the most, and red heads the fewest, about 90,000.

questions.question: How long is the record for holding your breath?
questions.definition: AIDA static apnea record, breathing only air first
questions.fact: Breathe pure oxygen beforehand and the record is over 29 minutes.

questions.question: How wide is an adult human eyeball?
questions.fact: At birth it is already 16 to 17 mm across, and it reaches full size by about age 12.

questions.question: How much does an adult human liver weigh?
questions.fact: It is the largest internal organ, though healthy adult livers range from about 0.6 to 1.9 kg.

questions.question: How much does an ostrich egg weigh?
questions.fact: That is over 20 times a chicken's egg, yet it's the smallest egg of any bird relative to the mother's size.

questions.question: How far does an Arctic tern fly in a year?
questions.definition: average for birds nesting in Greenland and Iceland
questions.fact: It flies from the Arctic to the Antarctic and back, the longest migration known in the animal kingdom.

questions.question: How deep can an emperor penguin dive?
questions.fact: That dive, by a penguin from the Auster colony in 1994, lasted 21.8 minutes.

questions.question: How fast can a hummingbird's heart beat?
questions.definition: fastest measured, in a blue-throated hummingbird
questions.fact: At night, in a torpor, a hummingbird's heart can slow to around 50 beats a minute.

questions.question: How fast can a cheetah run?
questions.fact: Its acceleration is the real weapon: from 0 to 97 km/h in under 3 seconds.

questions.question: How tall is the Burj Khalifa in Dubai?
questions.definition: to the top of its spire
questions.fact: From its upper floors you can watch the sun set again, minutes after it has set at ground level.

questions.question: How tall was the Great Pyramid of Giza when it was built?
questions.definition: as built, before its outer casing was stripped
questions.fact: It was the tallest human-made structure in the world for more than 3,700 years.

questions.question: How tall is the Leaning Tower of Pisa?
questions.definition: from the ground, on the low side
questions.fact: Its top leans about 3.9 m out from the vertical.

questions.question: How long is the Hong Kong–Zhuhai–Macau Bridge?
questions.definition: the whole crossing, link roads included
questions.fact: It is the longest sea crossing in the world; the main bridge alone runs 29.6 km.

questions.question: How high does Hong Kong's Central–Mid-Levels escalator climb?
questions.fact: It covers 800 m of hillside, and riding it end to end takes twenty minutes.

questions.question: How far apart are Russia and the US across the Bering Strait?
questions.definition: mainland to mainland, at the narrowest
questions.fact: In the middle of the strait, Russia's Big Diomede and the US's Little Diomede islands are just 3.8 km apart.

questions.question: How many people live in Greenland?
questions.fact: That makes it the least densely populated country in the world.

questions.question: How long is the Trans-Siberian Railway?
questions.fact: It crosses eight time zones, a record for one railway line.

questions.question: How many people live in Antarctica in winter?
questions.fact: In summer the number swells to about 4,000.

questions.question: How much wider than Earth is the Sun?
questions.fact: The Sun holds 99.86% of all the mass in the Solar System.

questions.question: How tall is Olympus Mons, the giant volcano on Mars?
questions.fact: It covers an area about the size of Italy.

questions.question: How tall was the Saturn V rocket?
questions.definition: with the Apollo spacecraft on top
questions.fact: Its first stage alone was 42 m tall and 10 m wide.

questions.question: How long is a year on Mars?
questions.fact: So its seasons last nearly twice as long as Earth's.

questions.question: How much did the heaviest pumpkin ever grown weigh?
questions.fact: A giant pumpkin can put on up to 23 kg in a single day.

questions.question: How much can a single jackfruit weigh?
questions.fact: It is the largest fruit that grows on trees, up to 90 cm long.

questions.question: How many hot dogs did the record holder eat in 10 minutes?
questions.fact: In 2001 Takeru Kobayashi ate 50, nearly doubling the old record of 25.5.

questions.question: How long is a typical French baguette?
questions.fact: In the 19th century some French loaves were far longer, about 1.8 m.

questions.question: How much does a standard central bank gold bar weigh?
questions.definition: the Good Delivery bar that central banks trade
questions.fact: The largest gold bar ever made, cast in Dubai in 2024, weighed 300.12 kg.

questions.question: How far does the world's longest non-stop passenger flight go?
questions.definition: Singapore Airlines, New York to Singapore, 2026
questions.fact: It is scheduled to take nearly 19 hours.

questions.question: How long is the Ever Given, which blocked the Suez Canal?
questions.fact: Wedged across the canal in 2021, it blocked traffic for six days and backed up over two hundred ships.

questions.question: How tall is Mount Everest?
questions.fact: China and Nepal once argued over whether to count its snow cap, a difference of about 4 m.

questions.question: How tall is the tallest known living tree?
questions.fact: It has grown about 67 cm since it was first measured in 2006.

questions.question: How deep is Lake Baikal, the world's deepest lake?
questions.fact: It holds more water than all of North America's Great Lakes combined.

questions.question: How much can the fastest-growing bamboo grow in one day?
questions.fact: Most garden bamboos grow a more modest 3 to 10 cm a day in their growing season.

questions.question: How long is the Great Barrier Reef?
questions.fact: It is made up of over 2,900 separate reefs and 900 islands.

questions.question: How much does one litre of mercury weigh?
questions.fact: Old lighthouse lenses floated on a bath of mercury, which worked as a bearing.

questions.question: How fast does Earth spin at the equator?
questions.fact: It slows away from the equator: about 1,184 km/h at 45° latitude, and zero at the poles.

questions.question: How hot is it at the surface of Earth's inner core?
questions.fact: That is about as hot as the surface of the Sun.

questions.question: How hot is the hottest part of a candle flame?
questions.fact: The hottest spot is just above the dull blue part at the base; the bright yellow zone is cooler.

questions.question: How fast did Usain Bolt run at his top speed?
questions.fact: His average over the whole race, start included, was 37.58 km/h.

questions.question: How high is the men's high jump world record?
questions.fact: Javier Sotomayor set it in 1993, and nobody has beaten it since.

source.title: Men's high jump world record progression

questions.question: How fast is the fastest badminton smash recorded in a match?
questions.fact: The fastest tennis serve on record is only about 60% as fast.

questions.question: How much does the FIFA World Cup trophy weigh?
questions.fact: It is hollow: in solid gold it would weigh 70 to 80 kg, too heavy to lift.

questions.question: How much does a table tennis ball weigh?
questions.fact: The rules also say it must bounce 24 to 26 cm when dropped from 30.5 cm onto steel.

questions.question: How many soldiers are in China's Terracotta Army?
questions.fact: Every figure is life-sized, about 1.75 to 2 m tall, and the officers are the tallest.

questions.question: How tall is Michelangelo's David?
questions.fact: It was only measured exactly in 1998-99, and turned out taller than any source had said.

questions.question: How long is the Bayeux Tapestry?
questions.fact: It is only about 50 cm tall, and tells the story of the Norman conquest of England.

questions.question: How tall are the letters of the Hollywood Sign?
questions.fact: The original 1923 sign read HOLLYWOODLAND, in letters about 15 m tall, and was meant to last only a year and a half.

questions.question: How many people came to the Woodstock festival in 1969?
questions.fact: The organisers had told the town to expect no more than 50,000.

questions.question: How long is the Nile?
questions.fact: Some scientists argue the Amazon is longer: it depends on where you say each river starts and ends.

source.title: List of river systems by length

questions.question: How many trips are taken on the Shanghai Metro each year?
questions.fact: No metro system in the world carries more passengers.
